explanation: A real review by Maria Pia Campagna et al. exists with a substantially related full title, but it was published in Clinical Epigenetics in 2021, not Nature Reviews Genetics in 2018. Web search also surfaced Nature Reviews Genetics epigenetics reviews from 2018, but not this Campagna citation in that venue/year.
mismatches: title: claimed "EWAS: knowledge, strategies, recommendations", actual "Epigenome-wide association studies: current knowledge, strategies and recommendations"
venue: claimed Nat Rev Genet, actual Clinical Epigenetics
search_attempts: web searched: "Epigenome-wide association studies: current knowledge, strategies and recommendations" Campagna
web searched: "Campagna MP" "Nat Rev Genet" EWAS 2018
web searched: "Nature Reviews Genetics" "Epigenome-wide association studies" "2018"
